requirements.summary: Build a RAG application over the final consolidated SQLite catalog with grounded product evidence and citations.
Provide a practical web interface for text search and RAG answers inside the catalog-rag project.
Keep the existing consolidator and final catalog safe while adding RAG and UI as an independent project.
Verify that catalog answers are factually supported by retrieved evidence and causally change when relevant catalog facts change.
Implement product changes through bounded repository SDD and DeepSeek Harness runs rather than direct Codex implementation.
Keep normal tests and release gates deterministic and offline through injected fake providers; make credentialed smoke tests opt-in.
Separate SDD delivery cost from runtime embedding and answer usage and never fabricate unavailable cost as zero.
The observed final schema has Product, ProductIdentity, and SellerProduct with canonical identity and seller-scoped text identifiers.
The observed disposable final catalog has 976 products and identities, 268 seller links, and limited descriptive fields, so one product document is sufficient for the first baseline.
